title: VIXEN needs a declared per-TU preprocessing and timing witness
body: R839 measurement required two failed ad-hoc queued g++ command constructions (nested jq quoting exit 127, then duplicate -o); the lane had to parse compile_commands.json, strip the compile output/source suffix, invoke g++ -H -E, count edges, and compress the output manually. Add a non-default CMake profiling target that emits per-source compile seconds, preprocessed bytes, include-edge count/depth, and stable evidence paths. Tier luna: normal tooling change with a differential witness; effort M.

title: VIXEN incremental app builds rerun stale codegen from provider timestamps
body: A queued incremental ninja build after a capture-only source edit marked the cached kernel CodegenTool and golden checks dirty because the provider archive timestamp was newer than build-tu01/codegen/tool/.complete; an unrelated TU isolation witness then reran codegen and consumed 81 seconds. Add a stable codegen freshness/pin witness or dependency timestamp normalization so per-TU incremental builds do not rebuild codegen when generated inputs are unchanged. Tier luna: normal tooling change with a differential witness; effort M.
